result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where you operate, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll only or payroll plus HR.

**My top recommendation for most small businesses is Gusto** if you're operating in the United States. It combines payroll processing, tax filings, employee benefits, and HR tools in an easy-to-use platform.

However, if your business is in Canada, I'd recommend looking at Canadian payroll platforms instead. Payroll tax rules and compliance requirements are very different.

## Best payroll software compared (2026)

Primarily U.S. options — not all are suitable for Canadian payroll.

## If you're operating in Canada

I would prioritize Canadian payroll compliance, including\:

- CRA payroll deductions and remittances.
- CPP and EI calculations.
- T4 and Relevé 1 support where applicable.
- Vacation pay and statutory holiday calculations.
- Workers' compensation reporting where supported.

A U.S.-focused platform like Gusto shouldn't be your default choice for Canadian employees.

My Canadian shortlist would be\:

| Software | Best for |
|--------|--------|
| Wagepoint | Best overall for small businesses |
| QuickBooks Payroll | Businesses using QuickBooks |
| PaymentEvolution | Budget-conscious businesses |
| Knit | Payroll plus basic HR |
| Payworks | More hands-on payroll support |


Wagepoint is my starting recommendation for a small Canadian employer. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
